changeSet.author: Vadil K.
changeSet.comment: Remove blank auto-created profiles (legacy createEmpty flow) that were never filled in and carry no family link.

sql.sql: DELETE FROM profile p WHERE p.first_name IS NULL AND p.last_name IS NULL AND p.gender IS NULL AND p.date_of_birth IS NULL AND p.residence IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile c WHERE c.father_id = p.id OR c.mother_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marriage m WHERE m.husband_id = p.id OR m.wife_id = p.id)
